Madrid eviction protests reignited by death of 87-year-old woman

Protests against evictions have been reignited in Madrid following the death of 87-year-old Maricarmen. Her eviction had previously sparked housing protests in Spain. The circumstances surrounding her death and the eviction have energized demonstrators demanding action on housing rights.
